name: cloudflare_update_dns_record
description: REPLACE an existing DNS record (HTTP PUT) — every field not sent is reset to its default, so you must resend `type`, `name`, and `content` even if only one is changing. For a small edit (flip `proxied`, change just `content` or `ttl`), prefer cloudflare_patch_dns_record instead. Requires `zone_id`, `record_id`, `type`, `name`, `content`. Optional `ttl` (1 = automatic), `proxied`, `priority` (MX/SRV), `comment`. This changes live DNS — confirm the record and values first.

zone_id.description: The zone id the record belongs to.

record_id.description: The DNS record id to replace.

content.description: Record value: IPv4 for A, IPv6 for AAAA, hostname for CNAME/MX, string for TXT.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds. 1 means 'automatic'.

proxied.description: Route through Cloudflare's proxy. Only valid for A, AAAA, CNAME.

priority.description: Priority — required for MX and SRV records.

comment.description: Optional note stored on the record.
